text: At a Saturday demonstration outside the Kestrel Works depot, Corvane staff told the Gazette the new E3 delivery van has a stated range of 290 kilometres on a full charge. I watched the vehicle circle the loading yard twice before stopping beside a row of mock delivery bays, where engineer Mara Venn said the figure came from the company’s latest test cycle. She added the van can regain “most of a working day” in a short midday charge. Driver Leon Saye, who took part in the run, said the cabin was quieter than the firm’s older model and the dashboard showed 287 kilometres remaining after the first loop. The launch was held on 12 June.
